landing.title: FlowHR
landing.subtitle: Multi-tenant HR SaaS
landing.description: Attendance, leave, approvals, and documents in one place — on web, mobile, and desktop.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Enter your email and password.
login.reset_success: Your password has been reset. Sign in with your new password.

error.locked: Locked after 5 failed attempts. Try again in {minutes} minute(s).
error.locked_generic: Your account is temporarily locked after repeated failures. Please try again shortly.
error.two_fa_expired: Your verification timed out. Please sign in again.

error.length: Password must be at least 10 characters.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.subtitle: We'll email you a link to reset your password.
forgot.sent_desc: If your email is registered, you'll receive a password reset link. Please check your inbox.
forgot.sent_hint: If you don't see it, check your spam folder or try again shortly.

error.email_invalid: That doesn't look like a valid email.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subtitle: Enter the password you'd like to use.
reset.session_warning: Resetting will sign you out of all active sessions on every device.
reset.invalid_title: This reset link has expired or is invalid
reset.invalid_desc: Reset links are valid for 60 minutes only. Please request a new one.

error.weak_password: Your password doesn't meet the requirements. Please satisfy all the rules below.
error.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
error.session_invalid: Your session has expired. Please request a new reset link.
error.update_failed: Failed to reset your password. Please try again.

two_fa.title: Two-factor authentication
two_fa.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
two_fa.recovery_link: Use a recovery code (no access to your app?)
two_fa.recovery_one_time: Recovery codes are single-use and disappear once used.

security.title: Security settings
security.subtitle: Manage two-factor authentication (2FA) and account security.
security.enabled_desc: Sign-in additionally requires a 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
security.disabled_desc: Set up 2FA with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, etc.) to better protect your account.
security.forced_banner: Operator accounts must enable two-factor authentication. Please complete setup below.
security.operator_required_note: Operator accounts cannot disable two-factor authentication per security policy.

enroll.scan_title: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app
enroll.scan_desc: Scan with Google Authenticator, Authy, etc., or enter the key below manually.
enroll.codes_desc: Single-use codes to sign in when you can't use your app. Store them somewhere safe.
enroll.codes_warning: These codes are shown only now. You won't be able to see them again after leaving this page.

error.session: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.setup_expired: Setup timed out. Please start over.
error.code_invalid: The code does not match. Please check and try again.
error.operator_blocked: Operator accounts cannot disable two-factor authentication.
error.disable_input: Please enter both your password and a verification code.

legal.must_accept_desc: Please agree to the terms below to continue using the service.
legal.consent_error: Failed to record consent. Please try again.

app.placeholder_notice: This screen will be implemented in a later sprint.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you requested does not exist or has been moved.

internal.title: Internal server error
internal.description: Please try again in a moment. If the problem persists, contact support.

maintenance.title: System maintenance in progress
maintenance.default_message: We are performing maintenance to improve the service. Please try again shortly.
